name: Directional Scaled
description: The second clip pushes the first out of the frame, both scaled down while they slide and back up as the push ends. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction of the movement; only the sign of each component counts (x right, y up)

params.name: scale
params.description: Size of the clips in the middle of the push
